  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"extract_metadata":true}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><title>Scholarly Work</title><meta name="DC.title" content="Principles of Knowledge Management"><meta name="DC.creator" content="Dr. Alice Johnson"><meta name="DC.date" content="2023-06-15"><meta name="DC.subject" content="Knowledge Management"><meta name="DC.publisher" content="Academic Press"></head><body><p>This is a scholarly article.</p></body></html>', options: options);
